name: list_quota_preferences
description: Lists QuotaPreferences of all quotas for a given project, folder, or organization. Expected request structure: 'parent' (string, format: projects/{project}/locations/global, folders/{folder}/locations/global, or organizations/{organization}/locations/global) and 'filter' (string, optional, e.g. 'service="compute.googleapis.com" AND quotaId="CPUS-per-project-region" AND dimensions.region="us-central1"'). Pagination is automatically fixed to 100 items per page.

parameters.description: Virtual request message for ListQuotaPreferences via MCP facade.

filter.description: Optional. Filter result QuotaPreferences by their state, type, or time range.

pageSize.description: Optional. Requested page size. Server may return fewer items than requested.

pageToken.description: Optional. A token identifying a page of results the server should return.

parent.description: Required. Identifier. Parent value of QuotaPreference resources.
